answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. A beacon of per-task receipts records who did what, and the quill of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, published publicly on failure. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the lagoon of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
